The '''Vactooine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was home to [[Vactooine]] and the [[Moon of Vactooine]]. The [[Svivreni]] mineralogist [[Kitalic Nirasik]] once directed the ore barge fleets in the system.
